title: Epstein's listening post at One Brattle Square

tellings.quote: He had another listening post called One Brattle Square.

plain: Eric Weinstein, a mathematician and podcaster, says on Jesse Michels's show that Jeffrey Epstein, the wealthy financier, kept what Weinstein calls a "listening post" at One Brattle Square, an address in Cambridge, Massachusetts, near Harvard, in the 2000s. Weinstein links it to the Harvard scientist Martin Nowak and to files about Epstein that have been released to the public. The point, as he tells it, is that Epstein placed himself where he could keep watch on leading scientists.
